purpose: Teach: 多かれ/暮し/所々/苛立ち/うかがえる/真中/縮め/探し出し

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、人は多かれ少なかれ苦労してた
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, people always carried some kind of hardship with them.
lines.style: Soft, distant gaze into memory. Slow, measured pace. Settling into the weight of recollection without self-pity. Quiet acceptance.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、質素な暮しを大事にされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, Grandpa always believed in a modest life, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Warm recognition, like watching him across fifty years. Gentle confirmation, not question. Affectionate teasing wrapped in tenderness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お家の壁が所々ひび割れてた
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, the walls of our house had cracks running through them here and there.
lines.style: Pauses before the image settles. Voice softens on the word 'cracks'. Not complaining—observing. The detail matters because he was there.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、苛立ちを表に出されない方だったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, you never let your frustration show, did you, dear?
lines.style: Admiring exhale on the opening. Not quite a question—a gentle statement of what she witnessed. Pride held quietly in her voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんのご様子から優しさがうかがえる場面だった
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, I could see such kindness in the way my father carried himself.
lines.style: Voice catches slightly on 'kindness'. The memory is vivid. Slow, careful delivery. Reverence without ceremony.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お庭の真中に椅子を置かれてたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, you used to sit in that chair in the middle of the garden, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Bright recall of a small, domestic moment. Warm smile in the voice. Intimate—she's painting the scene from inside it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが古着を縮めて直された
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, my father would mend old clothes for us, making them fit just right.
lines.style: Quiet pride in the detail. Voice steady but touched. The practicality and care woven together. Present-tense feeling in past memory.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、無くしたお宝を探し出しが上手だったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, you had such a gift for finding what was lost, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Final line carries a soft close, as if she's summing him up. Voice fades gently. Affectionate, wistful. A benediction.
